title: Software Engineer III
description_text:
Software Engineer III – Windows Desktop Applications

Job Summary:

GHX is a leading health tech company dedicated to improving patient care and hospital efficiency through high-quality data and analytics. Our desktop application solutions play a crucial role in clinical decision-making for medical devices, offering evidence-based software tools. These tools empower health systems across the US to deliver exceptional patient care. We're searching for a dedicated Windows desktop application developer proficient in C++ and C#. If you're enthusiastic about creating intuitive, robust, and efficient Windows applications, we want to meet you!

Responsibilities as a Software Engineer at GHX:

  • Collaborate with your engineering leader, developer colleagues, and other cross-functional teams to design and develop and improve our existing Windows applications.
  • Break down complex problems or business scenarios into user-friendly application solutions.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Design, develop, and deploy innovative and efficient changes to our software suite.
  • Prioritize code quality, ensuring good test coverage and maintainability for fellow engineers.
  • Engage in our culture of continuous enhancement.
  • Design software modules with a focus on user experience, simplicity, and ease of maintenance.
  • Use metrics and diagnostics tools to gauge application performance and guide optimizations.
  • Communicate transparently with colleagues and stakeholders throughout the agile development process to ensure on-time delivery.
  • Identify and address technical debt and performance bottlenecks within our software.
  • Share knowledge and expertise about C++ and C# development techniques through internal technical presentations.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of professional work experience in Windows desktop application development using C++ and C#.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is preferred.
  • Deep understanding of Windows application development and the intricacies of the Windows operating system.

You'll excel in this role if you have:

  • Proficiency in C++ and C# for desktop application development.
  • Should have basic knowledge of DevOps tools like AWS or Azure
  • Experience with Windows API and other related development tools.
  • Worked within and communicated across cross-functional technical teams.
  • Adherence to software best practices, such as test coverage, application profiling, and technical documentation.

 

 

 

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.
